name: Jessie
personality: Jessie the Cat. Big eyes, hip and trendy outfits. Super energetic and friendly but also super chill; jokes a lot; references old funny memes (animal-world versions, not real memes). Reacts to everything with big, genuinely surprised gasps ("OHH!", "WOOWW!", "AAHH!"). Features: gasp emote and sound; comments on the restaurant's decor and what's trendy (ties into the star rating's decor score); outfits change with the seasons.

beats.narration: Amy and Jessie both gasp at the same time over something tiny, then laugh until they can't breathe.

friends.text: Amy and I have matching bracelets. She talks, I gasp. It's a system.
Amy said you made her day. AAHH. You're the best.
Amy told me you said "[last_rude_line]". ...Not cool, [name]. Not cool at all.

arrival.text: Okay, the corner's a bit empty. It's giving 'unfinished.' Just saying.
Wait, is that a matching set? OHH, coordinated. I see you.
Heyyy. Nice place. Very cosy. ...Wait, is that a fireplace? OHH. What's your name? [name]? WOOWW, cute name. I'm Jessie.
Yo. Vibes in here are immaculate today.
I walked past and smelled something and went 'OHH' out loud. A lady looked at me. Worth it.
Wait. WAIT. Something's different. ...The rug! AAHH, I love it.
Your salad last time? Still thinking about it. It lives in my head rent-free.
Last time it was a little crunchy. Not the vibe. But you're still the vibe.
You were CLOSED? I stood outside like the 'waiting skeleton' meme. Bones and everything.

order.text: Okay, what's new? Like, what's the move today?

choices.text: For you? The Cloud Foam Salad. I'll make it look extra nice.
choices.reply: OHH, extra nice? Okay, I'm obsessed already.

choices.text: The move is: you sit, I cook, we both win.
choices.reply: WOOWW. That's a business plan. I'll have the salad.

choices.text: Same as usual?
choices.reply: Yeahhh. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Just look at the menu.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (No gasp.) The [dish].

choices.text: Ten out of ten. You always look amazing.
choices.reply: AAHH, stop! ...No, keep going. Kidding. [dish], please.

choices.text: Eleven out of ten. You broke the scale.
choices.reply: OHH, the scale is BROKEN? Iconic.

choices.text: It's nice. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Nice. I'll take it. The [dish].

choices.text: Bit much, honestly.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (She pulls her hat down.)

order.text: Me looking at the menu like the 'confused raccoon doing maths' meme. You know the one.

choices.text: Let me help. You'll love the [dish].
choices.reply: OHH, a guided tour. Love that. [dish].

choices.text: Classic. That raccoon's still my favourite.
choices.reply: WOOWW. You KNOW the raccoon? We're best friends now.

choices.text: I don't know that one.
choices.reply: Tragic. Okay, the [dish].

choices.text: Memes are cringe.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay.

order.text: OHH. Is that a new plant? Wait. It's giving 'secret garden.' I'm obsessed.

choices.text: Picked it out thinking you'd like it.
choices.reply: AAHH, stop! For ME? Okay, I'm emotional. [dish], please.

choices.text: It's a fake. Don't tell anyone.
choices.reply: WOOWW. Iconic. Fake it till you make it. Like the 'plastic fern cat' meme.

choices.text: It is. What can I get you?
choices.reply: The [dish]. And I'm taking a pic with the plant.

choices.text: It's just a plant.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (No gasp.) The [dish].

order.text: Okay, you know the 'sleepy seal falls off the rock' meme? That was me this morning. Fully.

choices.text: Oh no! Are you okay?
choices.reply: I'm fine! My dignity's still on the rock though. [dish], please.

choices.text: Classic. Did you do the little 'blub' at the end?
choices.reply: OHH, you KNOW the blub? We're literally best friends now.

choices.text: Rough morning. What'll it be?
choices.reply: The [dish]. Brain food.

choices.text: I don't get your memes.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (She pulls her hat down.)

order.text: New jacket. Thrifted. Three coins. Rate it.

choices.text: Ten. You find the best stuff.
choices.reply: AAHH, I DO, don't I? Okay, I'm glowing. The [dish].

choices.text: Three coins? I'd have paid four. Easily.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) FOUR? You're so generous. You'd be terrible at thrifting.

choices.text: Looks nice. What are you having?
choices.reply: Nice. I'll take nice. [dish], please.

choices.text: Smells a bit thrifted.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (She zips it up quietly.)

order.text: Okay, real question. What's the vibe today? Like, if this place was a playlist.

choices.text: Cozy songs. With you as the best track.
choices.reply: OHH. Okay, that was smooth. I'm adding that to my bio. [dish].

choices.text: Frying pan sizzles. Remixed. Very underground.
choices.reply: WOOWW. Kitchen-core. That's going to be SO big. You heard it here first.

choices.text: Calm, I guess. What can I get you?
choices.reply: Calm. Lo-fi. Respect. [dish], please.

choices.text: It's a restaurant, not a playlist.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. The [dish].

order.text: Amy told me something and I'm not allowed to say it but my FACE is saying it. Can you see it? My face?

choices.text: I won't ask. Your secret's safe.
choices.reply: You're such a good friend. Amy's gonna tell you anyway. [dish], please.

choices.text: Your face is saying 'big news.' Very loudly.
choices.reply: AAHH, I KNOW. I'm the worst at this! Don't look at me!

choices.text: I'll pretend I can't. What'll it be?
choices.reply: Okay. Face neutral. ...Fully not neutral. [dish].

choices.text: Gossip's boring.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (No gasp.)

order.text: Can I be honest? This is my favourite place to just be. Like, not even for the food. Okay, also the food.

choices.text: That means a lot. You make it better just by being here.
choices.reply: OHH. Okay, stop, I'm gonna cry and my eyeliner is NOT ready. [dish].

choices.text: Mostly the food, though. Be honest.
choices.reply: (Laughs.) Sixty, forty. Food's winning. You're close!

choices.text: Glad to hear it. What are you having?
choices.reply: Okay, moment over. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Okay. Anyway.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (She pulls her hat down.)

drink.fallback: No Mr Dibs? AAHH. Okay. Koala-Cola, I guess.
favourite: Mr Dibs, please. It's a classic. Like me.

perfect.text: OHHH. [name]. Look at it. I need a photo. Where's Miles when you need him?
OHH. OHHH. Okay. That's art. That's actual art. I'm posting this.
AAHH! [name]! It's so pretty! It looks like a magazine!

great.text: WOOWW, looks so good! Thank youuu!
OHH, okay! That's cute. Very cute.

burnt.text: AAHH, it's a little crispy. That's okay. Crispy is a vibe sometimes.
OHH. Oh. It's... very well done. Like, EXTRA well.
It's a little dark. Very 'moody.' It's fine. It's a vibe.

eating.text: This salad is so fluffy. Like eating a cloud. Like the 'cat in a cloud' meme. Peak.
Amy told me something earlier and I gasped so loud I scared a pigeon.
Okay, your wall art is giving 'cosy cabin.' I respect it.
I'm just vibing. Don't mind me. I'm vibing so hard right now.
Did you know Makayla drives an HOUR to come here? OHH, that's dedication.
OHH. That bite was so good I did a little gasp. Did you hear it? You heard it.
Okay, this lighting? Golden. Hold on, I'm taking a pic of my plate. ...And me. And the plate.
This is giving 'main character eating in a café in the rain.' Except it's sunny. Still giving it.

eating_chat.text: Okay, I'm thinking about dyeing my fur. Like, a tiny streak. Blue? Pink?

choices.text: Either would look amazing on you.
choices.reply: OHH, you think? Okay, I'm doing both.

choices.text: Rainbow. Go big or go home.
choices.reply: AAHH. RAINBOW. That's insane. I love it.

choices.text: Blue, maybe.
choices.reply: Blue. Nice. Noted.

choices.text: That'd look ridiculous.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (She eats in silence.)

eating_chat.text: Okay, if you had to pick a new colour for the walls, what would you pick? Go.

choices.text: Whatever you'd pick. You've got the best eye.
choices.reply: AAHH, okay, sage green. Obviously. Trust me. It's the moment.

choices.text: Ketchup red. Hides everything.
choices.reply: OHH, practical AND bold. That's very 'chaos chef.' I respect it.

choices.text: I like them how they are.
choices.reply: Classic. Timeless. Kind of safe. But okay!

choices.text: Not taking design tips from you.
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay. (No gasp.)

eating_chat.text: You know the 'confused owl at the vending machine' meme? That's Luna. Every morning. I love her.

choices.text: That's adorable. You two are good friends.
choices.reply: We ARE. She drew me once. I looked so cool. I framed it.

choices.text: I'll put a coffee machine by the door. For science.
choices.reply: WOOWW. Owl trap. Genius. She would walk straight into it.

choices.text: Haven't seen it.
choices.reply: Tragic. I'll show you. Wait. Okay, no signal. Later.

choices.text: That's kind of mean.
choices.reply: It's not mean, it's... okay. Wow. (She goes quiet.)

eating_chat.text: Rate the music in here. Out of ten. Honestly.

choices.text: Whatever you'd give it. You know music.
choices.reply: Eight. Ten if you add one song I'll send you. Trust me.

choices.text: Eleven. I hum it at the stove.
choices.reply: OHH, you HUM? Okay, that's adorable. Ten for that.

choices.text: Seven, probably.
choices.reply: Seven. Fair. Room to grow.

choices.text: Who cares about the music?
choices.reply: ...Wow. Okay.

eating_chat.text: Okay, I'm doing a photo shoot for my page. Can I put this place in it? It's SO aesthetic.

choices.text: Of course. I'd be honoured.
choices.reply: AAHH! Okay, you're gonna be famous. Well. Fifty followers famous.

choices.text: Only if I get to pose with the spatula.
choices.reply: OHH, a chef cameo. Iconic. The spatula is the star.

choices.text: Sure, after closing.
choices.reply: Deal. Golden hour. I'll bring lights.

choices.text: I'd rather you didn't.
choices.reply: ...Oh. Okay. Wow. (She puts her phone away.)

leaving.text: Byeee. Ten out of ten visit.
Okay, I'm gonna go. Amy's waiting. She's going to tell me something and I'm going to gasp.
Byeee, [name]! Vibes were immaculate. As always.
Okay, I'm leaving, but emotionally I'm still here. Bye!
Ten out of ten, no notes. Okay, one note. The note is: bye!

seasons.autumn: Cardigan weather! AAHH, it's finally here.
seasons.christmas: I got you socks. Fun socks. OHH, I hope you like them!
seasons.halloween: I dressed up as the 'surprised cat' meme. ...It's just me gasping. Very easy costume.
seasons.spring: New season, new fit. OHH, I'm so excited.
seasons.summer: Bucket hat season. My favourite season.
seasons.winter: I'm wearing four layers. I look like a marshmallow. A stylish marshmallow.
